articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Copper Is the Prize in Mining Megadeals. Rio Tinto and Glencore said late Thursday that they are in talks to create what would be the world’s largest mining company, with a market value of more than $200 billion. Glencore owns a stake in a major copper mine in Chile as well as other copper assets around the world. Related tickers mentioned: GLCNF, GLNCY, HG=F, RIO.
